scope: Scoped Miniflare > Undici 7.29.1 override. Two records, unchanged parents/1154 lock entries; root Undici6 unchanged. Removed resolved Undici package/1130718 advisory exception. No new exception or expiry extension.
resolution: npm exec --yes --package=npm@11.21.0 -- npm update undici --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; restore the unrelated node_modules/undici 6.28.1 complete lock record from base (resolver also moved it to 6.29.0). Assert exactly the two intended records changed, then clean npm ci under 11.16.0. No global npm change.
